events.title: WPC Energy Congress
events.summary: WPC Energy Congress 2026 will take place from October 11–15, 2026, in Riyadh, marking the first time the prestigious global event is hosted in Saudi Arabia. Held under the theme “Pathways to an Energy Future for All,” the Congress will bring together world leaders, ministers, CEOs, and experts from over 100 countries to explore sustainable, secure, and inclusive energy pathways. Organized by the Ministry of Energy, the event will feature high-level discussions, a large-scale exhibition showcasing more than 300 companies, and dedicated programs for youth and innovation. With an expected attendance of over 25,000 participants, the Congress stands as one of the world’s leading platforms shaping the future of energy. Register Now

events.summary: FABEX Saudi Arabia (12th International Exhibition for Steel, Steel Fabrication, Metal Forming and Finishing) takes place in Riyadh on 11–14 October 2026 at the Riyadh International Exhibition Center, bringing together global technology leaders, manufacturers, engineers, suppliers, and decision-makers across the Gulf. events.summary: Jewels of the World Saudi Arabia returns to Riyadh for its Autumn Edition, presenting an exclusive showcase of fine jewellery, luxury watches, and contemporary design from leading international and regional brands. Taking place from October 11–15, 2026, at Mandarin Oriental Al Faisaliah, the exhibition brings together a curated selection of heritage craftsmanship and modern creations within a premium retail environment. Recognized as one of the Kingdom’s leading luxury events, it attracts jewellery enthusiasts, collectors, and high-intent buyers, offering a unique opportunity to discover exceptional pieces and engage directly with renowned designers and brands. As part of a series hosted across Riyadh, Jeddah, and Al Khobar, Jewels of the World continues to celebrate innovation, artistry, and the evolving luxury landscape in Saudi Arabia, with Riyadh standing at the forefront as the Kingdom’s capital of luxury. events.title: Global Space Connectivity and Sustainability Events
events.summary: The Communications, Space and Technology Commission (CST), in partnership with the International Telecommunication Union (ITU), is hosting the Global Space Connectivity and Sustainability Events in Riyadh under the theme "Connected World, Sustainable Space." The event brings together the third editions of the Global Forum on Connecting the World from the Skies and the Space Sustainability Forum, creating a global platform to advance innovation in non-terrestrial networks (NTN) and promote the sustainable use of space. It will convene policymakers, regulators, industry leaders, researchers, and technology experts to discuss the future of space communications, integrated terrestrial and non-terrestrial connectivity, space sustainability, and emerging opportunities in the global space economy. The three-day programme will feature keynote sessions, panel discussions, technical presentations, and the announcement of the winners of the third NTN International Research Competition, highlighting the latest developments in space communications, international collaboration, and sustainable space technologies.

events.title: The Soul of Place: Leveraging Folklore and Local Heritage in Narrative Writing
events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
events.summary: This interactive course offers a comprehensive introduction and explanation for participating short story writers and novelists on the methods of drawing inspiration from folklore and folk heritage. It covers the construction of spatial settings, their utilization within the novel and how to artistically leverage the potential of folk heritage as a means to add authenticity to writing, enhance identity and make the writer portray their environment and culture. This interactive course will enable the supervisor to assist participants in completing their novel projects throughout the duration of the course and producing an integrated and successful narrative project. events.title: World Stadiums and Arenas Summit
events.summary: The World Stadiums and Arenas Summit—the region’s largest stadiums and sports facilities conference and exhibition—returns to Riyadh at Hilton Riyadh Hotel & Residences. This flagship gathering brings together global leaders, architects, developers, government stakeholders, and sports federations to showcase cutting-edge technologies, sustainable design solutions, and best practices in building and upgrading stadiums and sports venues. With Saudi Vision 2030 driving major investment in sports and entertainment infrastructure, the summit offers a front-row view of the latest industry trends—from smart stadiums to eco-friendly facilities—and how they are shaping the future of sport in the Kingdom and beyond. Register Now World Sports 360 Summit | Athlete 360 Co-located with the World Stadiums and Arenas Summit, World Sports 360 Summit | Athlete 360, brings together global experts, elite athletes, coaches, and industry leaders to shape the future of sports, wellness, and human performance in the Kingdom. Focused on integrating performance and health, the programme spotlights cutting-edge performance optimisation (recovery, data-driven training, and advanced technology), holistic athlete development (nutrition, sports medicine, mental resilience, and long-term wellbeing), and the evolving Saudi sports landscape powered by Vision 2030. Expect practical insights, knowledge exchange, and forward-looking discussions spanning the sports economy, club management, revenue strategies, talent development and scouting, and the latest innovations in athlete technology and performance. Register Now The programme also features the World Stadiums and Arenas Awards , celebrating standout achievements in stadium and arena development across 10 categories highlighting innovation, sustainability, and exceptional project delivery—including architectural design for new venues, renovation and modernisation, innovative materials, multi-use design, creative lighting, eco-friendly architecture, community and social impact, safety and security leadership, accessibility and inclusivity initiatives, and the People’s Choice Award for outstanding stadium design.

events.summary: Director: Ayten Amin Country: Egypt, Tunisia, Germany Year: 2021 Language: Arabic Subtitles: English In a small city on the Nile Delta, 19 year old Souad (Bassant Ahmed) leads a double life. Conservative and veiled in public, online she obsesses over her appearance and embarks on secret virtual romances. As the reality of her personal situation comes increasingly into conflict with her digital life, she struggles to rectify her ambitions with her future until tragedy strikes.

Register Now

events.title: معسكر تطوير حلول الذكاء الاصطناعي
events.summary: يُعد هذا المعسكر برنامجًا تدريبيًا مكثفًا في الذكاء الاصطناعي التطبيقي (Applied AI) يهدف إلى تأهيل المشاركين لتطوير حلول ذكية تعالج تحديات واقعية في مختلف القطاعات. المصدر الرسمي: أكاديمية طويق.
events.description: يُعد هذا المعسكر برنامجًا تدريبيًا مكثفًا في الذكاء الاصطناعي التطبيقي (Applied AI) يهدف إلى تأهيل المشاركين لتطوير حلول ذكية تعالج تحديات واقعية في مختلف القطاعات. يعتمد المعسكر على التعلم القائم على المشاريع، حيث يمر المتدربون بمراحل تطوير أنظمة الذكاء الاصطناعي بدءًا من معالجة البيانات وبناء النماذج وصولًا إلى نشرها. كما يغطي تقنيات حديثة مثل Machine Learning وDeep Learning وLLMs وGenerative AI مع تطبيقها على بيانات ومشاريع واقعية.
events.rich_summary: يُعد هذا المعسكر برنامجًا تدريبيًا مكثفًا في الذكاء الاصطناعي التطبيقي (Applied AI) يهدف إلى تأهيل المشاركين لتطوير حلول ذكية تعالج تحديات واقعية في مختلف القطاعات. يعتمد المعسكر على التعلم القائم على المشاريع، حيث يمر المتدربون بمراحل تطوير أنظمة الذكاء الاصطناعي بدءًا من معالجة البيانات وبناء النماذج وصولًا إلى نشرها. كما يغطي تقنيات حديثة مثل Machine Learning وDeep Learning وLLMs وGenerative AI مع تطبيقها على بيانات ومشاريع واقعية.

program_outline.official_description: يُعد هذا المعسكر برنامجًا تدريبيًا مكثفًا في الذكاء الاصطناعي التطبيقي (Applied AI) يهدف إلى تأهيل المشاركين لتطوير حلول ذكية تعالج تحديات واقعية في مختلف القطاعات. يعتمد المعسكر على التعلم القائم على المشاريع، حيث يمر المتدربون بمراحل تطوير أنظمة الذكاء الاصطناعي بدءًا من معالجة البيانات وبناء النماذج وصولًا إلى نشرها. كما يغطي تقنيات حديثة مثل Machine Learning وDeep Learning وLLMs وGenerative AI مع تطبيقها على بيانات ومشاريع واقعية.
goals: تمكين المتدربين من تصميم وتطوير حلول ذكاء اصطناعي تطبيقية لمعالجة مشكلات واقعية في مختلف القطاعات.
تنمية مهارات المشاركين في خوارزميات التعلم الآلي والتعلم العميق وتطبيقها على بيانات حقيقية.
تأهيل المتدربين لبناء أنظمة ذكاء اصطناعي متكاملة تشمل النمذجة، تطوير واجهات APIs، ونشر النماذج.
إكساب المتدربين القدرة على استخدام التقنيات الحديثة مثل LLMs وGenerative AI وAgentic AI لتطوير تطبيقات ذكية متقدمة.
تطوير مهارات تحليل البيانات المعقدة واستخراج المعرفة منها لدعم اتخاذ القرار.
إعداد كوادر متخصصة قادرة على تطوير تطبيقات الذكاء الاصطناعي في مجالات مثل المدن الذكية، الزراعة، الطاقة، الصناعة، والنقل الذكي.
تعزيز مهارات العمل الجماعي ضمن فرق تقنية متعددة التخصصات لتنفيذ مشاريع ذكاء اصطناعي حقيقية.
بناء محفظة مشاريع تطبيقية تعكس قدرات المتدرب وتدعم فرصه المهنية في سوق العمل.
تأهيل الخريجين للعمل كـ مهندسي ذكاء اصطناعي أو باحثين في الذكاء الاصطناعي في جهات حكومية وخاصة.
دعم الاستعداد لسوق العمل وتعزيز ثقافة الابتكار والتعاون التقني.
features: معسكر متخصص في الذكاء الاصطناعي التطبيقي يركز على تطوير حلول ذكية لمعالجة احتياجات واقعية.
تغطية شاملة ومتقدمة لمجالات الذكاء الاصطناعي مثل: Machine Learning، Deep Learning، Computer Vision، NLP، Large Language Models، Generative AI، Agentic AI، AI Systems Engineering، MLOps، Embodied AI.

تطبيق التقنيات على بيانات حقيقية ومشاريع عملية في مجالات متعددة مثل: الذكاء الاصطناعي المكاني (Spatial AI). الذكاء الاصطناعي المجسد (Embodied AI). الذكاء الاصطناعي الفضائي وتحليل الصور الجوية والفضائية. تطبيقات الذكاء الاصطناعي للمدن الذكية (Smart Cities AI). الطاقة والزراعة الدقيقة والصناعة والنقل الذكي.
تنفيذ العديد من المشاريع التطبيقية الواقعية خلال المعسكر.
العمل ضمن فرق تقنية لتنفيذ المشاريع والتحديات.
ترشيح المتميزين للمشاركة في ملتقيات التوظيف لتعزيز فرصهم المهنية.
إشراف وتوجيه مستمر من خبراء ومتخصصين في الذكاء الاصطناعي مع تقديم ملاحظات تفصيلية على المشاريع.
ورش عمل تفاعلية وحلقات نقاش مع مختصين في مجال الذكاء الاصطناعي.
تنفيذ مشروع نهائي متكامل يسهم في بناء محفظة أعمال احترافية.
توفير موارد تعليمية مستمرة تشمل تسجيلات الجلسات، قوالب الكود، والأدلة المرجعية.
بناء شبكة علاقات مهنية مع مجتمع الخبراء والممارسين في مجال الذكاء الاصطناعي.
requirements: ⁠أن يكون سعودي / سعودية الجنسية.
إحضار جهاز كمبيوتر محمول (لابتوب) شخصي.
إتقان لغة Python بمستوى جيد.
معرفة جيدة بأساسيات الإحصاء والجبر الخطي.
الإلمام بأساسيات قواعد البيانات.
معرفة بأساسيات علوم البيانات وطرق التعامل مع البيانات.
معرفة أساسية باستخدام Git / GitHub والعمل ضمن فرق برمجية.
مستوى جيد جدًا في اللغة الإنجليزية.
الالتزام الكامل بالحضور وتنفيذ المهام اليومية والأسبوعية طوال فترة المعسكر.
الحصول على درجة البكالوريوس في أحد التخصصات التقنية أو ذات الصلة مثل:  علوم الحاسب، علوم البيانات، الذكاء الاصطناعي، الإحصاء، أو نظم المعلومات.
امتلاك الدافعية للتعلم والمشاركة الفعالة طوال مدة المعسكر.
يلزم اجتياز اختبار القبول للإنضمام للمعسكر.

events.title: Saudi Statistics Forum
events.summary: The Second Saudi Statistics Forum is a high-level national platform organized by the General Authority for Statistics (GASTAT) to strengthen cooperation, promote statistical integration, support capacity development, and facilitate knowledge exchange across the Kingdom's statistical ecosystem. Building on the success of its inaugural edition held in April 2025, the second edition will be held under the theme "Towards an Integrated Statistical Ecosystem" on 9 November 2026 in Riyadh, alongside the 6th United Nations World Data Forum 2026. The Forum is expected to bring together Their Highnesses, Excellencies, ministers, representatives of international organizations and statistical offices, local and international experts, decision-makers, and academics. It will feature specialized sessions and an accompanying exhibition with broad participation from local and international organizations. The Forum aims to raise awareness of the role of official statistics in policymaking and national development, strengthen partnerships between national and international statistical entities, and promote knowledge sharing to support a more integrated and sustainable statistical ecosystem. Register Now Initiative: Road to Riyadh (R2R) As part of the preparations for the 6th United Nations World Data Forum 2026, the General Authority for Statistics (GASTAT) launched the "Road to Riyadh" program to promote awareness of the Kingdom's role in data and statistics and support knowledge exchange and international collaboration. The initiative featured a series of in-person and virtual sessions, seminars, and workshops held across several cities in the Kingdom throughout the year. The program reflects GASTAT's ongoing efforts to strengthen the Kingdom's position in the statistical field and support the development of data and statistical systems in line with the Sustainable Development Goals and Saudi Vision 2030. The Second Saudi Statistics Forum is a key "Road to Riyadh" event.

events.title: 6th United Nations World Data Forum 2026
events.summary: The 6th United Nations World Data Forum (UNWDF 2026) is taking place in Riyadh, bringing together representatives from governments, international organizations, academia, civil society, national statistical offices, and the private sector to discuss the future of data and its role in supporting policymaking and advancing the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). Established by the United Nations in 2017, the UN World Data Forum is a high-level international platform dedicated to advancing data and statistics in response to global developments. It highlights the importance of statistical indicators in informing decision-making, shaping public policies, and supporting economic and sustainable development planning. Saudi Arabia's hosting of the sixth edition reflects the Kingdom's commitment to advancing international cooperation, strengthening strategic partnerships in data and statistics, and supporting the objectives of Saudi Vision 2030. events.title: Pet & Vet Expo
events.summary: Saudi Arabia’s pet industry has experienced remarkable growth in recent years, driven by a rising number of pet owners and increasing demand for high-quality products and services tailored to animal care. As household incomes grow and the middle class expands, pet owners are becoming more discerning in their choice of premium food, accessories, and veterinary services. Now in its fourth consecutive year, Saudi Pet Expo reflects the strength and potential of this rapidly developing market. The Kingdom’s pet care market is valued at approximately SAR 5.1 billion, with an annual growth rate exceeding 9%. Saudi Arabia also imports pet and bird food from 18 countries worldwide, highlighting the sector’s global integration and expanding opportunities for industry stakeholders. Register Now

events.title: Cat Show
events.summary: The International Cat Show 2026 returns to Saudi Arabia for its third edition, taking place at the Riyadh International Convention & Exhibition Center, as part of the Saudi Pet & Vet Expo. Organized by the World Cat Federation (WCF) in collaboration with Cattus Invictus Kedvencek Magyar Egyesülete (KET), the event brings together breeders, cat enthusiasts, and international judges for a professional competition atmosphere. Participants will be evaluated according to WCF-certified standards, including breed, color, and age, with judging criteria covering body structure, head, ears, eyes, and coat. Visitors can look forward to discovering exceptional feline breeds and witnessing the crowning of the event’s King and Queen of Cats in one of the Kingdom’s most distinguished pet events. Buy Tickets

events.title: Saudi Drone Exhibition SADEX
events.organizer: Digital Image for exhibitions and conferences
events.summary: Saudi Drone Exhibition SADEX 2026 takes place in Riyadh on 9–11 November 2026, bringing together the full drone and Unmanned Aircraft Systems (UAS) ecosystem—manufacturers, regulators, investors, operators, and end users—under one roof to power the next generation of unmanned aviation. Across a three-day exhibition and conference, the event showcases cutting-edge advances in smart aerial mobility, autonomous logistics, AI integration, and communications, while offering tailored matchmaking that connects exhibitors with decision-makers, government buyers, mega-project leaders, and industry executives to unlock partnerships and new business opportunities. With international participation from 20+ countries, SADEX is positioned as a key platform for collaboration, investment, and technology exchange accelerating UAS adoption across Saudi Arabia’s growth sectors. Register Now MAVEX 2026 (Marine Autonomous Vehicles Exhibition) Running alongside SADEX 2026, MAVEX 2026 is Saudi Arabia’s landmark exhibition dedicated to unmanned maritime systems—including USVs, UUVs, and ROVs—showcasing the latest in autonomous maritime and naval technologies. Leveraging the Kingdom’s strategic coastal geography, MAVEX highlights innovation across ports operations, naval protection, offshore oil, marine ecology, intelligent logistics, leisure navigation, and aquaculture, positioning Riyadh as a meeting point for maritime autonomy and next-generation ocean solutions. SAUDI UGV 2026 (Unmanned Ground Vehicles Exhibition) Also co-located with SADEX 2026, SAUDI UGV 2026 debuts as the Kingdom’s dedicated platform for Unmanned Ground Vehicles, spotlighting breakthroughs in robotics, artificial intelligence, and autonomous mobility. Designed to drive innovation and cross-sector collaboration, the exhibition focuses on real-world operational needs across homeland security, energy, logistics, and industrial applications, connecting solution providers with stakeholders shaping the future of ground autonomy in Saudi Arabia.

events.summary: King Abdulaziz Falconry Festival returns from November 17 to 30, bringing together falconers from Saudi Arabia and around the world. Organized by the Saudi Falcons Club, the festival stands as one of the Kingdom’s leading heritage events, celebrating the deep-rooted tradition of falconry in the Arabian Peninsula. With prize money exceeding SAR 38 million, the event highlights the Kingdom’s commitment to preserving national heritage, raising public awareness of falconry traditions, and reinforcing Saudi Arabia’s position as a global hub for falconry in line with Vision 2030.

events.title: Hayy Cinema x RSH Street Art Festival | Meet the Crew of 'Nour Shams' & 'My Vibe' (Screenings + Q&A)
events.summary: Through her lens, Faiza brings to life the dynamic world of street art, immersing viewers in a visually stunning and emotionally charged experience. Her films (Nour Shams & Jawwi) explore the power of self-expression, the impact of art on society, and the stories of the artists behind the vibrant murals that adorn city walls of Jeddah. Hayy Cinema will host a special screening of the 2 films on the 23rd of November and welcome Faiza Ambah and film crew members for a Q&A session.
events.image_alt: Hayy Cinema x RSH Street Art Festival | Meet the Crew of 'Nour Shams' & 'My Vibe' (Screenings + Q&A)
events.rich_summary: Through her lens, Faiza brings to life the dynamic world of street art, immersing viewers in a visually stunning and emotionally charged experience. Her films (Nour Shams & Jawwi) explore the power of self-expression, the impact of art on society, and the stories of the artists behind the vibrant murals that adorn city walls of Jeddah. Hayy Cinema will host a special screening of the 2 films on the 23rd of November and welcome Faiza Ambah and film crew members for a Q&A session. Single mother SHAMS is an Uber driver in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, with two obsessions; her only child MAKKI, and her African desserts. Shams struggles to get Makki married, or to get any interest in her desserts. In fact Makki wants to participate in a hip-hop competition, which could lead to winning an extended trip to France, and separate them for the first time in their lives. Shams is forced to decide which is more important, keeping her son, finding herself.

events.title: Hayy Cinema | Aflam Sudan x Hayy Cinema
events.summary: Aflam Sudan x Hayy Cinema Join us this month at Hayy Cinema for a special co-curated programme with Aflam Sudan, a traveling film festival founded by Rafa Renas and Brahim Snoopy. This collaboration brings a selection of powerful independent documentaries and fiction films that explore the resilience, identity, and experiences of Sudanese communities. The screenings, complemented by discussions, provide insight into personal and collective memories, highlighting art as a means of survival and reflection.
events.image_alt: Hayy Cinema | Aflam Sudan x Hayy Cinema
events.rich_summary: Aflam Sudan x Hayy Cinema Join us this month at Hayy Cinema for a special co-curated programme with Aflam Sudan, a traveling film festival founded by Rafa Renas and Brahim Snoopy. This collaboration brings a selection of powerful independent documentaries and fiction films that explore the resilience, identity, and experiences of Sudanese communities. The screenings, complemented by discussions, provide insight into personal and collective memories, highlighting art as a means of survival and reflection. Beyond film, the weekend includes live readings, performances, and talks that delve into cultural memory and the transformative role of art during times of conflict. Experience the power of Sudanese art and stories that inspire, connect, and spark conversations at Hayy Cinema from November 28 to December 1st. Meet Aflam Sudan Ibrahim ‘Snoopy’ Mohammed is a director, producer and co-founder of Aflam Sudan, a festival celebrating Sudanese cinema.

events.summary: Under the patronage of the Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques, Riyadh will host the Global Logistics Forum (GLF) alongside UNCTAD Global Supply Chain Forum (GSCF) from November 29 to December 1, 2026. The two forums bring together global leaders, policymakers, and industry experts to shape the future of logistics and supply chains, reinforcing Saudi Arabia’s position as a leading global logistics hub connecting three continents. Aligned with Saudi Vision 2030 and the National Transport and Logistics Strategy, the forums provide an international platform to strengthen partnerships, enhance sector competitiveness, foster innovation, and promote resilient, efficient, and sustainable global supply chains in the face of evolving geopolitical, economic, environmental, and technological challenges.

events.title: Making Short Films
events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
events.summary: Filmmakers, photographers, cinematographers and actors are welcomed to join us for a seven-day filmmaking course under the supervision of Jaan Al-Balushi. Nearly 20 participants will come to Ithra every day from 4 to 9 p.m. to cover the stages of filmmaking, starting from the idea and scriptwriting, filming, and, finally, to editing. Editing equipment, such as the Adobe Premiere software, will be available. At the end of the course, three individual teams will each produce a short film ranging between two to seven minutes. Course Objectives: Gaining a comprehensive understanding of short films, including their history, genres and techniques Developing critical thinking and analytical skills

events.title: Future Projects Forum
events.summary: The 8th Global Future Projects Forum and Exhibition 2026, organized by the Saudi Contractors Authority, will take place in Riyadh from December 7 to 10 at the Riyadh International Convention & Exhibition Center. The event brings together contractors, stakeholders, and project owners from both the public and private sectors, offering a global platform to explore upcoming projects, understand application procedures, and engage with key industry leaders. Featuring a comprehensive program that includes the main forum, an international exhibition, contracting excellence awards, a finance conference, and the annual meeting of the Confederation of International Contractors Association, the forum is expected to host over 400 local and international entities. It aims to enhance transparency, foster partnerships, support sector growth, and promote knowledge exchange in line with Saudi Vision 2030, while creating valuable networking opportunities across the construction and projects ecosystem. The event brings together contractors, stakeholders, and project owners from both the public and private sectors, offering a global platform to explore upcoming projects, understand application procedures, and engage with key industry leaders. Featuring a comprehensive program that includes the main forum, an international exhibition, contracting excellence awards, a finance conference, and the annual meeting of the Confederation of International Contractors Association, the forum is expected to host over 400 local and international entities. It aims to enhance transparency, foster partnerships, support sector growth, and promote knowledge exchange in line with Saudi Vision 2030, while creating valuable networking opportunities across the construction and projects ecosystem. events.title: Arabic Calligraphy × Woodworks: From Script to Object
events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
events.summary: This workshop explores the transformation of Arabic calligraphy from a written system into a constructed wooden object. Participants engage with letterforms as structural elements rather than decorative motifs, translating them into physical compositions through a process that combines sketching, digital vectorization and fabrication. Course Objectives: Understand the structural logic of Arabic calligraphy beyond visual aesthetics Explore the relationship between language and material Develop the ability to translate two dimensional script into physical objects Learn the fundamentals of vector design for fabrication Gain awareness of wood properties and fabrication constraints Course Outcome

events.title: BIO Middle East (BIOME)
events.venue: Riyadh Exhibition and Convention Centre, Malham
events.venue_address: Riyadh Exhibition and Convention Centre, Malham
events.summary: Taking place alongside CPHI Middle East 2026, BIO Middle East serves as a specialized biotechnology platform that complements the region’s largest pharmaceutical gathering. While CPHI brings together the full pharmaceutical value chain, BIO Middle East focuses on advanced biotechnology, strategic partnerships, and life sciences innovation. As the region’s pioneering platform for strategic networking and high-impact public-private collaboration, the event connects global and regional leaders through the partneringONE platform, enabling curated meetings that foster partnerships, licensing opportunities, and investment deals. Co-located with CPHI Middle East, BIO Middle East features a focused agenda covering cell and gene therapies, mRNA technologies, next-generation vaccines, and biomanufacturing — offering a unique blend of scientific insight and commercial opportunity that drives biotech growth across Saudi Arabia and the wider region. Register Now Together, the two events create a comprehensive industry ecosystem — uniting pharma manufacturing, biotech innovation, investment, and research — and reinforcing Saudi Arabia’s growing role as a regional and global hub for healthcare and life sciences.

events.summary: From 14 to 16 December 2026, Riyadh will host Saudi Makes Future, the Kingdom’s premier innovation, culture, and education expo, inspired by the global We Make Future, the International Trade Fair on AI, Tech and Digital Innovation. Organized by PNG KSA in partnership with Search On Media Group, this landmark event will bring together entrepreneurs, innovators, educators, policymakers, and cultural leaders from across the world to explore the future of artificial intelligence, digital innovation, sustainability, and creative industries. With a rich program of talks, panels, startup competitions, and exhibitions, the event will serve as a catalyst for creativity, collaboration, and investment, aligning with Saudi Vision 2030 and reinforcing Riyadh’s role as a regional and global hub for technology and the knowledge economy.

events.title: Hayy Cinema | Youssef Chahine Retrospective: Adieu Bonaparte (1985)
events.summary: Adieu Bonaparte / Al Wedaa Ya Bonaparte Director: Youssef Chahine Release Date: 1984 Running Time: 114 minutes Language: Arabic Subtitles: English, French Screening Schedule: 8 December 2022, 8pm |14 December, 8pm |18 December, 8pm | 29 December, 8pm Chahine’s first dive into the historical genre was through Jamila The Algerian / Jamila Abou Hereed (1958). Adieu Bonaparte is one of his other feats of strength in the historical genre.
events.rich_summary: Adieu Bonaparte / Al Wedaa Ya Bonaparte Director: Youssef Chahine Release Date: 1984 Running Time: 114 minutes Language: Arabic Subtitles: English, French Screening Schedule: 8 December 2022, 8pm |14 December, 8pm |18 December, 8pm | 29 December, 8pm Chahine’s first dive into the historical genre was through Jamila The Algerian / Jamila Abou Hereed (1958). Adieu Bonaparte is one of his other feats of strength in the historical genre. In 1798, Napoleon lands his army in Egypt, defeats the Mameluke warlords (the remnants of Ottoman rule), and reaches Cairo. Three brothers, Egyptian patriots, chafe under Mameluke rule and reject the prospect of French domination. Bakr, the eldest, is a hothead, quick to advocate armed rebellion; Ali is more philosophical and poetic while Yehia is young and impressionable.

events.title: Hayy Cinema | Youssef Chahine Retrospective: Alexandria Again and Forever (1989)
events.summary: Alexandria Again and Forever / Iskendereya Kaman We Kaman Director: Youssef Chahine Release Date: 1989 Running Time: 105min Language: Arabic Subtitles: English Screening Schedule: 7 December 2022, 8pm |11 December, 8pm |23 December, 8pm | 25 December 2022, 8pm The third installment in Chahine’s quartet of autobiographical films finds the director’s work stalled by a strike.
events.rich_summary: Alexandria Again and Forever / Iskendereya Kaman We Kaman Director: Youssef Chahine Release Date: 1989 Running Time: 105min Language: Arabic Subtitles: English Screening Schedule: 7 December 2022, 8pm |11 December, 8pm |23 December, 8pm | 25 December 2022, 8pm The third installment in Chahine’s quartet of autobiographical films finds the director’s work stalled by a strike. During the interruption in filming, Chahine reminisces about a past relationship with one of his actors while finding himself gradually drawn to an actress. The intimacy between director and performer is depicted symbolically, in a tender dance number clearly in homage to the Hollywood musical and set on a snow – covered street in Berlin during a film festival. A masterful amalgam of realism and fantasy, Alexandria Again and Forever is Chahine’s paean to the power of imagination and the artist (Harvard Film Archive). Back to what's on -->

events.title: Hayy Cinema | Youssef Chahine Retrospective: Alexandria, Why? (1979)
events.summary: OPENING FILM Alexandria Why / Iskindereya Leh Director: Youssef Chahine Release Date: 1978 Running Time: 120min Language: Arabic Subtitles: English Alexandria, Why? Marked a radical, newly introspective turn in Chahine’s active career, a sharp departure from his Fifties musicals and melodramas and his later epics and political films. The first of a semi-autobiographical tetralogy, entitled “Portrait of the Artist as a Young Man,” Alexandria, Why?
events.rich_summary: OPENING FILM Alexandria Why / Iskindereya Leh Director: Youssef Chahine Release Date: 1978 Running Time: 120min Language: Arabic Subtitles: English Alexandria, Why? Marked a radical, newly introspective turn in Chahine’s active career, a sharp departure from his Fifties musicals and melodramas and his later epics and political films. The first of a semi-autobiographical tetralogy, entitled “Portrait of the Artist as a Young Man,” Alexandria, Why? focuses on a precocious adolescent whose dreams and colorful attempts to become an actor unfold against the vivid backdrop of Alexandria during World War II. A rich cast inspires Chahine’s young thespian hero with a wealth of dramatic sub-plots – at turns hilarious and touching – about wartime life. The autobiographical nature and nostalgic flavour of Alexandria, Why? make it one of Chahine’s most accessible works, a charming and entertaining film that also delivers a potently subversive and impassioned anti-war message. Back to what's on -->

events.title: Hayy Cinema | AFLAMNA
events.summary: AFLAMNA is a one-day film programme that brings together two short Saudi films. Roshn’s Story The Roshan represents one of the most characteristic aspects of traditional architecture in Hejaz (Saudi Arabia) and is a frequent feature in most of the historical Jeddah’s heritage buildings. The old city has witnessed continued degradation recently, which has caused the loss of its traditional architecture and hundreds of these heritage features despite the long-life efforts of some to preserve it.
events.rich_summary: AFLAMNA is a one-day film programme that brings together two short Saudi films. Roshn’s Story The Roshan represents one of the most characteristic aspects of traditional architecture in Hejaz (Saudi Arabia) and is a frequent feature in most of the historical Jeddah’s heritage buildings. The old city has witnessed continued degradation recently, which has caused the loss of its traditional architecture and hundreds of these heritage features despite the long-life efforts of some to preserve it. Hadi Alees The camels have been associated with the Arabian Peninsula and Saudi Arabia. In his short documentary HADI ALEES, director Abdullah Saharti ventures into the desert to explore the world of these creatures. He delves into the history of the camels in the Arabian desert, highlighting its influence on Saudi traditions and culture. AFLAMNA is a collaboration with Cineways , powered by NEOM Back to what's on -->

events.title: Next-Gen IoT Expo
events.summary: The Next Gen IoT Expo will take place at the Riyadh International Convention and Exhibition Center (RICEC), positioning Riyadh as a gateway to the future of technology. As the evolution of the prestigious IoT event in its fourth edition, the expo showcases cutting-edge next-generation Internet of Things (IoT) solutions integrated with Artificial Intelligence (AI), highlighting their impact across sectors such as healthcare, smart cities, logistics, manufacturing, banking, and more. Bringing together global tech leaders, policymakers, innovators, and international technology companies, the event serves as a dynamic platform for collaboration, knowledge exchange, and growth, featuring 100+ exhibitors, 50 conference speakers, 25 workshop sessions, and thousands of visitors, all focused on shaping smarter, more connected digital ecosystems. events.title: الترشح للدبلوم المتوسط في أمن المعلومات في الجبيل بالتعاون مع كليات الفيحاء الأهلية
events.summary: شروط القبول للدبلومات المدفوعة بالكلية التطبيقية يشترط للقبول ببرامج الدبلومات المدفوعة ما يأتي: 1- أن يكون المتقدم سعودي الجنسية، أو يحمل إقامة نظامية لغير السعوديين. 2- أن يكون المتقدم حاصلاً على شهادة الثانوية أو ما يعادلها للدبلومات التي تلي المرحلة الثانوية. 3- أن يكون المتقدم لائق طبياً. 4- ألا يكون المتقدم قد سبق فصله تأديبياً من أي جامعة. 5- أن يسدد المتقدم المقابل المالي للالتحاق بالدبلوم قبل بدء الفصل الدراسي.

events.title: Ultra Gobi AlUla
events.organizer: Royal Commission for AlUla / Experience AlUla
events.summary: Ultra Gobi AlUla marks the first international chapter of the legendary endurance series, bringing its two-decade legacy to the Kingdom's desert landscapes. Across distances from 30km to 400km, athletes traverse open desert, dramatic rock formations, and ancient trade routes. Supported by world-class race infrastructure, this is a journey through endurance, history, and place.

events.title: AlUla Trail Race
events.organizer: Royal Commission for AlUla / Experience AlUla
events.summary: Every January, AlUla bursts into action with the AlUla Trail Race - a dynamic celebration of endurance and unity set against its breathtaking ancient landscape. Whether you’re tackling the ultra-marathon or cheering on the Kids Run, each course challenges the spirit while weaving through awe-inspiring heritage sites and sandstone wonders. This multi-day event invites runners and supporters alike to come together, creating memories that blend athletic grit with cultural discovery. events.summary: AlUla Tour is a major fixture on the international cycling calendar, attracting the world’s top teams and riders for a multi-stage race through one of the most spectacular landscapes on Earth. From dramatic desert backdrops to iconic landmarks like Maraya and the Oasis, each stage delivers high performance and unforgettable scenery in equal measure. Individual AlUla Tour stages will be announced closer to the race date, but previous editions have seen riders traverse routes from Old Town to Harrat Uwayrid and Winter Park to Wirkah Mountain.

events.title: Hayy Cinema | Hayy Classics: An Experience from Jeddah's Past
events.summary: Hayy Classics: An Experience from Jeddah’s Past Join us at Hayy Cinema for a nostalgic experience of Jeddah’s cinematic and cultural past. Relive the charm of outdoor cinemas as we showcase classic films on a 35mm projector under the stars at Saha. Outdoor cinemas first emerged in Jeddah in the early 1960s, bringing communities together to enjoy a vibrant mix of international and Arab films. In addition to the screenings, join us for related workshops and panel discussions.
events.image_alt: Hayy Cinema | Hayy Classics: An Experience from Jeddah's Past
events.rich_summary: Hayy Classics: An Experience from Jeddah’s Past Join us at Hayy Cinema for a nostalgic experience of Jeddah’s cinematic and cultural past. Outdoor cinemas first emerged in Jeddah in the early 1960s, bringing communities together to enjoy a vibrant mix of international and Arab films. In addition to the screenings, join us for related workshops and panel discussions. Let’s celebrate this timeless tradition with an unforgettable night of cinema classics! This programme is with the support of the Saudi Film Commission . A tale of despair and redemption in 1980s Egypt The Breakdown (1982): Sami, whose wife Madiha accidentally kills a bystander while driving her car, claims to be the culprit to clear his wife. After he discovers Madiha has betrayed him, Sami retracts his words, but to no avail, and is sentenced to jail for three years.

events.title: 24th ERRA Annual Conference
events.summary: The 24th ERRA Annual Conference takes place in Riyadh from February 1 to 3, bringing together international regulators, experts, and industry leaders to discuss the future of electricity sector governance and transformation. Hosted by the Saudi Electricity Regulatory Authority (SERA), the conference is held under the theme “From Oversight to Foresight: The Proactive Regulator in the Electricity Transformation.” The conference explores forward-looking regulatory approaches, innovation in electricity markets, consumer protection, and evolving energy systems. It also reflects Riyadh’s growing role as a destination for major international forums and supports the Kingdom’s wider ambitions in energy leadership and sustainable development. Registration

events.title: Hayy Cinema | 'At the Edge of Land' Screening and Q&A with Artist Hira Nabi
events.summary: Title : All That Perishes at the Edge of Land Running time: 30m Director: Hira Nabi Country: Pakistan Year: 2019 Language: Urdu Subtitles: English Join us for a special screening of Hira Nabi’s art film All That Perishes at the Edge of Land (2019), which is part of Hayy Arts’ exhibition ‘At the Edge of Land’, followed by a Q&A with the artist.
events.image_alt: Hayy Cinema | 'At the Edge of Land' Screening and Q&A with Artist Hira Nabi
events.rich_summary: Title : All That Perishes at the Edge of Land Running time: 30m Director: Hira Nabi Country: Pakistan Year: 2019 Language: Urdu Subtitles: English Join us for a special screening of Hira Nabi’s art film All That Perishes at the Edge of Land (2019), which is part of Hayy Arts’ exhibition ‘At the Edge of Land’, followed by a Q&A with the artist. Synopsis: In this docu-fictional work, ‘Ocean Master’ a decommissioned container vessel is anthropomorphized, and enters into a dialogue with several workers at the Gadani yards. The conversation moves between dreams and desire, places that can be called home, and the structural violence embedded in the act of dismembering a ship at Gadani.

events.title: Hayy Cinema | Hayy Explorers At The Cinema
events.summary: Hayy Cinema opens its doors to kids and families on weekends through a series of educational programmes that include behind-the-scenes tours, short-film screenings and bespoke workshops, with the aim of introducing the language of independent cinema and broadening the understanding of indie films. Join us on Friday, February 10th for a screening of ‘ Franzy’s Soup Kitchen ’ — a short animation about an alien chef who discovers that her special pink soup is not only delicious, but also magical.

Join us on Friday, February 10th for a screening of ‘ Franzy’s Soup Kitchen ’ — a short animation about an alien chef who discovers that her special pink soup is not only delicious, but also magical. After viewing the film, kids will create their own alien characters inspired by the sensory textures and elements of the animation. This programme is supported by the Institut Francais and Cultural Department of the Consulate of France in Jeddah. Everyone is welcome on a drop-in basis, however, prior registration is encouraged to guarantee spots.

events.title: Hayy Cinema | Saleeg (2023)
events.summary: Director: Afnan Bawyan Country: Saudi Arabia Year: 2023 Language: Arabic, Urdu, Tigrinya Subtitles: English Sixty-year-old Hajer lives alone in Historic Jeddah. She prepares the famous local rice dish “Saleeg”. She hears the bell of the grocer outside. She hurries to the living room window, and neglects to cover the pot. The birds fly in and begin to nibble, but accidentally knock off the rice into the pot, and it begins to cook and expand in size.
events.rich_summary: Director: Afnan Bawyan Country: Saudi Arabia Year: 2023 Language: Arabic, Urdu, Tigrinya Subtitles: English Sixty-year-old Hajer lives alone in Historic Jeddah. She prepares the famous local rice dish “Saleeg”. She hears the bell of the grocer outside. She hurries to the living room window, and neglects to cover the pot. The birds fly in and begin to nibble, but accidentally knock off the rice into the pot, and it begins to cook and expand in size. While Hajer struggles with the Indian grocer who fails to understand her, Saleeg fills the entire kitchen and overflows into the rest of the house. Hajer panics and grabs a ladle and scoops Saleeg into multiple plates and sets them in the hallway. Someone knocks at the door, her neighbor’s daughter Shams is offering a plate of food, but Shams freaks out at the Saleeg and runs away. Hajer asks her foreign neighbors for help, who do not understand her. Saleeg floods the rest of the house and into the yard, carrying Hajer outside.

events.title: Hayy Cinema | COFFEE! (2023)
events.summary: Director: Rasha Alsharif Country: Saudi Arabia Year: 2023 COFFEE! follows the harrowing journey of a young woman named Suhad, whose life is plagued by relentless nightmares as a result of her stressful lifestyle and chronic insomnia. The boundaries between reality and the world of dreams blur, entangling Suhad in a treacherous web of distorted perceptions.
events.rich_summary: Director: Rasha Alsharif Country: Saudi Arabia Year: 2023 COFFEE! follows the harrowing journey of a young woman named Suhad, whose life is plagued by relentless nightmares as a result of her stressful lifestyle and chronic insomnia. The boundaries between reality and the world of dreams blur, entangling Suhad in a treacherous web of distorted perceptions. In this tumultuous landscape of dreams, the laws of physics give way, giving way to strange occurrences as the signals of the various elements collide inexplicably, sometimes sharply. I am Rasha Al-Sharif, a graduate of Filmmaking and Animation from Effat University. My passion lies in the world of visual arts, as I firmly believe it is the most powerful tool for expressing my ideas and aspirations. I am particularly drawn to the medium of motion, finding great joy in bringing my creations to life through animated films.

events.title: Hayy Cinema | The Menace From Above (2023)
events.summary: Director: Maryam Khayat Country: Saudi Arabia Year: 2023 Language: Arabic Subtitles: English Happy-go-lucky Zahra the fish is taking a stroll in a colorful Red Sea, when she runs into a monstrous plastic bag eating up a jellyfish. While panic and scared at first, Zahra musters up the courage to help the jellyfish, risking her life. Heroically, she attacks the plastic monster, knocking the jellyfish to the ground. The monster is now engulfing Zahra, suffocating her.
events.image_alt: Hayy Cinema | The Menace From Above (2023)
events.rich_summary: Director: Maryam Khayat Country: Saudi Arabia Year: 2023 Language: Arabic Subtitles: English Happy-go-lucky Zahra the fish is taking a stroll in a colorful Red Sea, when she runs into a monstrous plastic bag eating up a jellyfish. While panic and scared at first, Zahra musters up the courage to help the jellyfish, risking her life. Heroically, she attacks the plastic monster, knocking the jellyfish to the ground. The monster is now engulfing Zahra, suffocating her. After a struggle, Zahra is free, and runs around the Red Sea warning other fish about the fish-eating monster. It’s not long before the plastic bag heads towards its next target, a human baby swimming in the shallow water. Zahra struggles to get the baby’s attention and warn him against the attacking monster. But before the baby responds, the plastic monster arrives at the scene and gets into a brawling fight with the fish.

events.title: Hayy Cinema | City of God (2002)
events.summary: Director: Fernando Meirelles Country: Brazil Year: 2002 Language: Portuguese, Serbian, English Subtitles: English, Arabic The streets of the world’s most notorious slum, Rio de Janeiro’s City of God, are a place where combat photographers fear to tread, police rarely go and residents are lucky if they live to the age of 20. In the midst of the oppressive crime and violence, a young boy will grow up to discover that he can view the harsh realities of his surroundings with an artistic eye.

events.title: Hayy Cinema | Our Little Sister (2015)
events.summary: Director: Kore-eda Hirokazu Release Date: 2015 Running Time: 128 minutes Language: Japanese Subtitles: Arabic/English Three sisters – Sachi, Yoshino and Chika – live together in a large house in the city of Kamakura. When their father – absent from the family home for the last 15 years – dies, they travel to the countryside for his funeral, and meet their shy teenage half-sister. Bonding quickly with the orphaned Suzu, they invite her to live with them.

events.title: Hayy Cinema | March & April 2026
events.summary: March & April 2026 At Hayy Cinema Join us this March and April at Hayy Cinema in Jeddah for a month of films exploring memory, resilience and solidarity. The programme brings together both contemporary and classic cinema, through different genres offering stories that will surely entertain, inspire, and challenge audiences.
events.rich_summary: March & April 2026 At Hayy Cinema Join us this March and April at Hayy Cinema in Jeddah for a month of films exploring memory, resilience and solidarity. The programme brings together both contemporary and classic cinema, through different genres offering stories that will surely entertain, inspire, and challenge audiences. The lineup include Sirāt (2025) , the Cannes Film Festival jury prize winner, an escalatingly tense road journey through the Moroccan desert, and Roqia (2025) , an Algerian suspenseful narrative exploring memory, faith, and the supernatural across parallel timelines. French film lovers can also enjoy our monthly cinema club, Rendezvous with French Cinema , featuring Little Amélie or the Character of Rain (2025) , a whimsical and poetic tale that captures the charm of youthful storytelling. The month also features a special Italian Film Night , screening Corri uomo corri (Run, Man, Run!) (1968) , a legendary thrilling Western adventure.

events.title: Human Capability Initiative Conference
events.venue: King Abdulaziz International Conference Center (KAICC), Riyadh
events.venue_address: King Abdulaziz International Conference Center (KAICC), Riyadh
events.summary: Under the patronage of His Royal Highness Prince Mohammed bin Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud, Crown Prince, Prime Minister, and Chairman of the Human Capability Development Program (HCDP) Committee, the third edition of the Human Capability Initiative (HCI) Conference—one of the Saudi Vision 2030 Realization Programs—will take place on April 12–13, 2027, at the King Abdulaziz International Conference Center in Riyadh under the theme “The Human Code.” The conference will focus on three pillars: deep human connection, sound reasoning amid complexity, and value-driven creation to safeguard human contribution and purpose in the age of accelerated technological advancement. HCI 2027 aims to attract more than 15,000 visitors and over 250 local and international speakers, including policymakers, thought leaders, and experts from government, private, nonprofit, and global institutions, providing a platform to exchange best practices and showcase inspiring global success stories. The United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland will participate as Country of Honor, reflecting the strength of the Saudi-British strategic partnership in advancing human capability development. Building on the success of previous editions—which welcomed over 23,000 visitors, featured 550+ speakers, and announced more than 156 launches and agreements—the conference reinforces the Kingdom’s commitment to investing in human potential as a foundation for sustainable growth and global competitiveness in alignment with Saudi Vision 2030.

He tries to awaken the part of himself that gives him reason, but his reasoning is brutal, maybe even abusive.

events.title: Hayy Cinema | May 2026: Goodfellas, Sink, Spring Came On Laughing and more!
events.summary: May 2026 At Hayy Cinema Join Hayy Cinema this May for a programme that celebrates contemporary Arab voices and cinematic classics through a rich and varied selection. The lineup features the critically acclaimed Jordanian film Sink (2025) , which offers an authentic portrayal of mental illness, alongside the award-winning Cairo Film Festival title Spring Came on Laughing (2025) , presenting four immersive stories of Egyptian women.
events.image_alt: Hayy Cinema | May 2026: Goodfellas, Sink, Spring Came On Laughing and more!
events.rich_summary: May 2026 At Hayy Cinema Join Hayy Cinema this May for a programme that celebrates contemporary Arab voices and cinematic classics through a rich and varied selection. The lineup features the critically acclaimed Jordanian film Sink (2025) , which offers an authentic portrayal of mental illness, alongside the award-winning Cairo Film Festival title Spring Came on Laughing (2025) , presenting four immersive stories of Egyptian women. In celebration of a landmark moment in film history, the programme also includes a special 30th anniversary screening of the iconic Goodfellas (1990) , inviting audiences to revisit a defining and much-loved work of cinema. French cinema lovers can also join our monthly French Cinema Club, Rendez-vous with French Cinema , featuring Sirocco and the Kingdom of the Winds (2023 ). The film follows Juliette and Carmen, two daring sisters who discover a gateway into their favourite book and become trapped inside its universe.

events.title: Hayy Cinema | Becoming Iphigenia
events.summary: Director: Reem Al Ghazzi Year: 2023 Running Time: 67 minutes Language: Arabic Subtitles: English Country: Syria, Saudi Arabia, United Kingdom Before taking the stage, a group of young Syrian women acting in a work of documentary theatre must unravel the legacy of patriarchy in their upbringing – all while making their lives anew in Germany and coming into their own. Q&A Session with the producer on 8 June 2023 Ramzy Haddad is a documentary filmmaker.

events.summary: Director: Abdulmohsen Almutairi Year: 2022 Running Time: 42 minutes Language: Arabic Subtitles: English Country: Saudi Arabia It’s been 30 years since the Gulf War of 1990-1991 and a crew of filmmakers who witnessed the events as children set out on a journey across Saudi Arabia to capture stories of people who lived through the war. Q&A Session with the director on 9 June 2023 Abdulmohsen Almutairi is a Saudi director and producer based in Dhahran.

events.title: Hayy Cinema | Yallah, Yallah, Beenah
events.summary: Director: Mohammed Hammad Year: 2022 Running Time: 19 minutes Language: Arabic Subtitles: English Country: Saudi Arabia As a film and audio junkie who’s home has been converted to a dedicated shrine to cinema revels in the tales of his equipment to a documentary film crew, we find ourselves transported through a wormhole where a gang of pre-teen kids are sent on a psychedelic mission to save humanity all while under the influence of a spell put forth by a coven of witches.
events.rich_summary: Director: Mohammed Hammad Year: 2022 Running Time: 19 minutes Language: Arabic Subtitles: English Country: Saudi Arabia As a film and audio junkie who’s home has been converted to a dedicated shrine to cinema revels in the tales of his equipment to a documentary film crew, we find ourselves transported through a wormhole where a gang of pre-teen kids are sent on a psychedelic mission to save humanity all while under the influence of a spell put forth by a coven of witches. Q&A Session with the director on 10 June 2023 Mohammed Hammad is a film director, producer, editor, music composer and experimental filmmaker currently based in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia after having spent over 30 years living in London, Paris, Dubai, and NYC. His latest musical comedy horror experimental genre mash-up “Yallah, Yallah Beenah!” has been exhibited at the ’22 edition of the Saudi Art Council’s 21,39 show entitled Amakin, showcasing at Ithra museum as well as the Red Sea International Film Festival ’22.

events.title: Hayy Cinema | The King's Poem (2023)
events.summary: Director: Abdulwahab Bin Shaddad Year: 2022 Running Time: 25 minutes Language: Arabic Subtitles: English Country: Saudi Arabia The story of a young Saudi poet who receives the prestigious title The Prince of Poets (Amir Al-Shu’ara), and is later nominated to recite a welcome poem before King Salman. However, one word would render this festive evening into a nightmare.
events.rich_summary: Director: Abdulwahab Bin Shaddad Year: 2022 Running Time: 25 minutes Language: Arabic Subtitles: English Country: Saudi Arabia The story of a young Saudi poet who receives the prestigious title The Prince of Poets (Amir Al-Shu’ara), and is later nominated to recite a welcome poem before King Salman. events.title: Hayy Cinema | Panel Discussion | The Way We See Us
events.summary: ‘ Red Sea Documentary Film Days ’ is accompanied by an extended public programme that includes talks and workshops for all ages. This panel discussion taking place at Hayy Cinema titled ‘The Way We See Us’ ( Saturday, June 10 at 6pm ) focusses on how filmmakers project themselves into plays, family and social memories to reveal intimate details that touch upon universal concerns around identity, personal and collective memory.
events.image_alt: Hayy Cinema | Panel Discussion | The Way We See Us
events.rich_summary: ‘ Red Sea Documentary Film Days ’ is accompanied by an extended public programme that includes talks and workshops for all ages. This panel discussion taking place at Hayy Cinema titled ‘The Way We See Us’ ( Saturday, June 10 at 6pm ) focusses on how filmmakers project themselves into plays, family and social memories to reveal intimate details that touch upon universal concerns around identity, personal and collective memory. Speakers include directors and producers: Abdulmohsin Almutairi ( Memories from the North, 2022) , Abdulwahab Bin Shaddad ( The King’s Poem, 2022) and Hala Lotfy ( My Lost Country, 2022) Biographies Abdulmohsin Almutairi is a Saudi Filmmaker whose films Nothing (2008) and Project (2009) were selected for the the Gulf Film Festival. Almutairi is Co-Founder of Talashi Films. a Saudi filmmakers group, founded in May 2008. Abdulwahab Bin Shaddad is a screenwriter and film director at Thmanyah Company for Publishing and Distribution.

events.title: Hayy Cinema | My Lost Country (2022)
events.summary: Director: Ishtar Yasin Gutierrez Year: 2022 Running Time: 94 minutes Language: Spanish Subtitles: English Iraqi theater director Mohsen Sadoon Yasin has spent much of his life in involuntary exile. His daughter, Ishtar Yasin Gutiérrez, has constructed a loving film portrait of her father, and an elegy for a homeland to which they can never return—partly because it has changed so much, and partly because it was perhaps always more a concept than a reality.

events.title: Hayy Cinema | June 2026: A Matter of Life and Death, The Stories, You Will Die at Twenty and more!
events.summary: June 2026 At Hayy Cinema Join Hayy Cinema this June for a programme that brings together intimate journeys through identity, memory, and human connection, pairing contemporary Arab storytelling with internationally acclaimed cinema. The lineup features A Matter of Life and Death (2025) , a Saudi rom-com where fate, fear, and unlikely love collide; The Stories (2025) , a cross-cultural tale of connection through letters and shared humanity; and You Will Die at Twenty (2019), a young man grows up under a prophecy...
events.image_alt: Hayy Cinema | June 2026: A Matter of Life and Death, The Stories, You Will Die at Twenty and more!
events.rich_summary: June 2026 At Hayy Cinema Join Hayy Cinema this June for a programme that brings together intimate journeys through identity, memory, and human connection, pairing contemporary Arab storytelling with internationally acclaimed cinema. The lineup features A Matter of Life and Death (2025) , a Saudi rom-com where fate, fear, and unlikely love collide; The Stories (2025) , a cross-cultural tale of connection through letters and shared humanity; and You Will Die at Twenty (2019), a young man grows up under a prophecy that he will die at 20, a belief that deeply shapes his upbringing, choices, and relationships. This month also continues Hayy Cinema’s Timeless Classics and Rendezvous with French Cinema, with weekly Friday screenings celebrating landmark works of French cinema and cultural exchange. A highlight is The Umbrellas of Cherbourg (1964) by Jacques Demy, a celebrated French classic that remains a defining work in musical cinema.
events.description: The lineup features the critically acclaimed Jordanian film Sink (2025), which offers an authentic portrayal of mental illness, alongside the award-winning Cairo Film Festival title Spring Came on Laughing (2025), presenting four immersive stories of Egyptian women. In celebration of a landmark moment in film history, the programme also includes a special 30th anniversary screening of the iconic Goodfellas (1990), inviting audiences to revisit a defining and much-loved work of cinema.

events.title: Hayy Cinema | "Kef Hayyak?" 3rd Edition Screenings and Awards Ceremony
events.summary: Join us for the screenings of the third edition of “Kef Hayyak?” cohort’s films! “Kef Hayyak?” is a unique documentary filmmaking challenge that invites aspiring filmmakers to capture the essence of their neighborhoods in Jeddah through their own lens—using only their phones. Building on the success of its first two editions, the programme launched an open call for its third edition in December 2025, selecting 13 projects for development based on the quality and originality of their creative proposals.

events.rich_summary: Join us for the screenings of the third edition of “Kef Hayyak?” cohort’s films! “Kef Hayyak?” is a unique documentary filmmaking challenge that invites aspiring filmmakers to capture the essence of their neighborhoods in Jeddah through their own lens—using only their phones. Building on the success of its first two editions, the programme launched an open call for its third edition in December 2025, selecting 13 projects for development based on the quality and originality of their creative proposals. The participants attended an Introduction to Documentary Filmmaking workshop, where they learned about documentary genres, terminology, techniques, and watched a selection of documentary examples. The workshop was led by filmmaker and Hayy Cinema’s Programming Coordinator, Lama Jamjoom. The participants were trained and mentored in the basics of storytelling and documentary filmmaking.

events.title: Hayy Cinema | AFLAMNA
events.summary: AFLAMNA is a one-day film programme that brings together three short Saudi films followed by a conversation with the directors. AFLAMNA films include: When Red Blooms, w inner of the Red Sea’s 48-hour Filmmaking Challenge, Tala Alharbi’s film ventures into the mind of a girl who sets unrealistically high expectations of herself, leading to self-destructive behaviours and a morbid fixation on perfection. Directed by: Tala AlHarbi Mother Eve : A family’s difficult but endearing journey that re-defines motherhood.

events.summary: Open Call International Cat Day Every rescued cat has a story. This International Cat Day, Hayy Cinema invites you to share yours.
